verification_scope: Selected visible publisher body passages from ten item pages were inspected. The batch contains English translations, not independent original-language witnesses. Context remains partial; the complete source texts, original-language transcripts, recordings, incoming correspondence, cited works and later outcomes were not independently inspected.
rights_note: Only concise non-verbatim Hebrew research paraphrases and precise body-line locators were stored; no protected letter or talk was copied in full.
quality_note: Each proposition is bounded to the specified visible passage. No missing audience, incoming question, participant identity or historical outcome was reconstructed.
